description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans client-addressable objects, including various scenarios such as method invocation, error propagation, pull model, and stress testing, implemented using Xunit.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTests
classes.description: A test class for Orleans client-addressable objects, covering function invocation, error handling, polling, and stress tests.

classes.name: MyPseudoGrain
classes.description: A mock client object implementing IClientAddressableTestClientObject, simulating different invocation scenarios and stress tests.

classes.name: MyProducer
classes.description: A mock producer implementing IClientAddressableTestProducer, used for polling-based data retrieval.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableHappyPath
methods.description: Unit test verifying that a client object can be called successfully from a grain and the return value is correct.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableSadPath
methods.description: Unit test verifying that exceptions from client-object methods are propagated properly to the grain.

methods.name: GrainShouldSuccessfullyPullFromClientObject
methods.description: Test for the pull model where grains retrieve data from client objects.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableSerialStressTest
methods.description: Stress test for serial invocation order and correctness of client objects.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableParallelStressTest
methods.description: Stress test for parallel invocation concurrency and thread safety.
